segments.title: Chương 109: Đùa thằng khờ
segments.content:
Before Bian Guanyue came down, the dorm aunty arrived first.

"Hurry up and put these away, or I'm sweeping them all into the trash can!" the dorm aunty scolded, a broom and dustpan in her hands.

Peng Haoran didn't have time to argue with Chen Guiliang and rushed over to stop her. "You manage this too?"

The dorm aunty questioned, "Don't you know Fire Safety Month is almost here?"

"What Fire Safety Month?" Peng Haoran genuinely didn't know.

The dorm aunty explained, "November 9th is Fire Safety Day, so the entire month of November is Fire Safety Month. The university just sent out a notice to strengthen fire prevention work across the campus. These candles of yours, hurry up, put them out and take them away."

Peng Haoran asked, "Singing is okay, right?"

The dorm aunty thought for a moment. "Keep it down, don't disturb the other students. Now hurry and clean up the candles!"

Peng Haoran could only put down his guitar and tell his bandmates to pick up the candles.

Some of the students in the crowd had already started to laugh.

It was mainly because the scene was too comical. A group of very artsy-looking guys were obediently bending over to clean up the site after just a few scolding words from the dorm aunty.

They had bent over to arrange the candles before, but that was to create a romantic atmosphere.

Now, well...

Peng Haoran felt he was losing face. He straightened his back and said, "You guys clean up first, I should start singing."

"Why should we?" a band member said, a little unhappy.

"Exactly. You're trying to pick up a girl and making us lose face? We're not putting up with this shit today, bro!"

Seeing the drummer and bassist getting emotional, Peng Haoran quickly said, "I didn't mean it like that. My treat tomorrow, whatever you want to eat."

Before his two bandmates could agree, Chen Guiliang was already fanning the flames from the side. "Bro, this is where you're wrong. Since you're brothers in the same band, you should be equals in status and character. Are you using your brothers as manual labor for just one meal? Are they your lackeys or your friends?"

What could have been resolved with a single meal was now impossible for the other two to accept after Chen Guiliang's words.

They all had their pride!

Even the keyboardist stopped picking up candles, otherwise it would be like admitting he was someone's lackey.

Peng Haoran was furious. "Who the fuck are you? What business is it of yours?"

With a look of profound disappointment, Chen Guiliang turned to the crowd of students and said, "Everyone, come and be the judge. I heard CUEB has an awesome band, so I made a special trip here from PKU, transferring several times. I came to visit CUEB's band with admiration, but instead, I encountered this. The lead singer doesn't even treat his bandmates like brothers. A band like this, no matter how well they sing, isn't worthy of my appreciation."

Chen Guiliang suddenly raised his voice. "Such a disappointment, such a huge disappointment! To think CUEB's band is of this caliber, so much worse than ours at PKU. Our bands at PKU, let's not even talk about how well we sing, at least we're all equals, united and friendly!"

"Shut up!"

Peng Haoran was so angry he reached out and shoved him.

Chen Guiliang staggered back in a very exaggerated manner, fell to the ground, then climbed back up, patting the dust off his clothes and shouting, "Is this how all CUEB students are? Resorting to violence when they can't win an argument? I'll definitely go back to PKU and spread the word!"

I didn't even use much force... Is he trying to frame me!

"I get it now, you came here specifically to cause trouble today." Peng Haoran rolled up his sleeves and stepped forward, wanting to teach Chen Guiliang a lesson.

Chen Guiliang quickly ran towards the dorm aunty, deliberately kicking over the heart-shaped candles on his way. "Aunty, help! A student from your school is trying to beat me up."

The dorm aunty had no choice but to intervene, scolding, "No fighting, or I'll report it to the university!"

Peng Haoran pointed at Chen Guiliang and said, "I don't even know you. First, you caused trouble to stop me from singing, and now you're sowing discord in my band. You think I'm an easy target, huh? If you've got the guts, let's go one-on-one. You pick the time and place."

Chen Guiliang asked doubtfully, "Isn't this the 21st century? Why are CUEB students still holding on to medieval customs?"

A male student watching the commotion couldn't take it anymore. "Hey buddy, if you two have a personal conflict, just resolve it yourselves. There's no need to drag CUEB into it every time you open your mouth, right?"

Chen Guiliang pointed at Peng Haoran. "Isn't this person from your university?"

The guy said, "He only represents himself, he can't represent the university."

Chen Guiliang had a sudden realization. "Oh, I get it. Good things are a collective honor, but bad things are an individual's actions. This is a very interesting social phenomenon. I'm going to start a thread on the PKU BBS to discuss it."

The guy wanted to say something but held his tongue.

Bian Guanyue had already come downstairs, and her five roommates came with her.

"Is that your boyfriend? Do you want to go help?" the dorm leader asked.

Bian Guanyue said, "As long as we don't cause any trouble, it's fine. He has his own way of handling things."

Her roommate from the lower bunk worried, "He's not going to get beaten up, is he?"

Bian Guanyue muttered, "It'll be good as long as he doesn't beat someone else up."

"Did he used to get into fights often?" Lin Ruonan caught the key point.

Bian Guanyue said, "Not really."

Chen Guiliang had already taken out a digital camera and was taking several pictures of the surroundings, taunting, "Come on, hit me. I want all the netizens to see how good CUEB students are at beating people up."

Video recordings were useless, as video websites didn't exist yet.

Posting photos on forums was the mainstream way.

Chen Guiliang clenched his fists. There was no sign of him seeing red yet, but he needed to be pushed a little further.

Peng Haoran continued to provoke him. "So he's only good at bragging and hitting on girls, and he even has balls. You should go to a second-hand book market someday and find a copy of the Bixie Sword Manual to give him."

"Hahaha!"

All the students burst out laughing, their funny bones apparently tickled.

"Bro, let's kill him!"

The laughter made Chen Guiliang lose it. He had completely lost his senses and bypassed the dorm aunty to try and hit him.

Peng Haoran ran, telling the girl, "Hey, that CUEB student is about to commit violence again."

For some reason, this girl stepped forward to block Chen Guiliang. "He's a little muddle-headed. He's going to embarrass your university!"

"Get out of the way!"

Chen Guiliang shoved her aside.

The girl was enraged. "Fuck, is he crazy? I was trying to break up the fight!"

Peng Haoran praised in a low voice, "So CUEB isn't full of good students, and I thought you were all nice people. Hey you, I really admire him. Standing up for the reputation of the school and all its students, daring to fight against a rotten apple like that who spoils the whole barrel!"

The girl turned her head and said, "Can you please stop fanning the flames?"

Before Peng Haoran could reply, Chen Guiliang yelled, "Who did he call a rotten apple?"

"He didn't name any names. If someone wants to be a rotten apple, they can take the shoe if it fits," Peng Haoran said with a smile.

"Fuck your mom... Stop right there!"

"Help, a CUEB student is going to hit someone again."

Chen Guiliang was so mad he swung his fist and charged. The girl and the dorm aunty hurried to block him, while Peng Haoran kicked over more heart-shaped candles as he fled.

The confession scene was a complete mess.

"What are they standing there for? Get over here and help!" Peng Haoran yelled at the band members.

The other members of the band looked at each other, not knowing if they should go and help.

The onlookers see most of the game. They could already tell that the PKU student was provoking Chen Guiliang and treating him like an idiot.

If they went to help, they'd become idiots too.

Chen Guiliang seemed to have poor stamina, gasping for breath after chasing for just a short while.

Peng Haoran, however, was full of energy. He rode his bike everywhere every day, so he had gotten into good shape.

"Huff... huff... huff..."

Peng Haoran deliberately mimicked Chen Guiliang's heavy breathing, looking incredibly punchable. "With stamina like this, you want to fight me? I'm afraid you couldn't even last three minutes with a 'jianguo'er'."

"'Guo'er'" was slang in the Beijing arts scene.

A young girl was called a "xianguo'er" (fresh fruit), and a particularly beautiful one was a "jianguo'er" (top fruit).

The remark was extremely cutting. Chen Guiliang instantly flew into a rage, cursing as he charged forward. "Fuck you!"

Peng Haoran ran circles like the King of Qin around the pillar, using the dorm aunty and the girl as his pillars.

After running for a while more, Chen Guiliang was so tired he had to stop, bending over with his hands on his knees, just panting, unable to speak.

Peng Haoran stood a few steps away. "Tsk, tsk, tsk... with this kind of stamina, one minute at most."

The girl said speechlessly, "Could you say one less thing?"

Just then, someone from the Student Affairs Office arrived.

The dorm aunty had called them.

The person who came was just a staff member on duty, not any kind of leader. He first scolded the crowd of students, "Disperse, quickly! Go to sleep if you should be sleeping, go study if you should be studying!"

Then, he said to Peng Haoran and Chen Guiliang, "You two, come with me to the Student Affairs Office!"

Bian Guanyue hurried over. "Sir, this is my boyfriend. He came all the way from PKU to see me."

"We'll talk about it at the Student Affairs Office," the staff member said, wanting to resolve the issue elsewhere.

The other band members, however, took the opportunity to slip away.

Peng Haoran actually chased after them. He pulled out a set of Legends of the Three Kingdoms cards and said to the drummer who had been the first to express his dissatisfaction, "Hey, I have a gift for you."

"For me?" The drummer was a bit stunned.

Peng Haoran said, "I think that in a band, everyone should be brothers, equal in character. That guy uses his brothers as lackeys, that's just not right. You were the first to protest, which I find very admirable. So, I want to give you a gift to show my respect. Please, you must accept it!"

While the drummer was hesitating, Chen Guiliang spoke up, "San'er, if you fucking take that thing, don't blame me for not treating you like a brother."

Peng Haoran took the card set back and sighed, "Forget it. Your boss has given an order, I won't make things difficult for you."

"What fucking boss is he!"

The drummer snatched the card set and pointed at Chen Guiliang. "I've had enough of you for a long time. Just because your family has some stinking money, what the hell are you so smug about? Chasing girls, smoking, and drinking all day, you have no stamina and no voice, and you still have the nerve to be the lead singer? Pfft! I'm not putting up with this anymore!"

"You've got guts!" Peng Haoran gave him a thumbs up.

The drummer turned to ask the keyboardist and bassist, "You guys choose for yourselves. Anyway, I'm done playing with him."

The two of them hesitated for a few seconds, then both chose to side with the drummer.

Chen Guiliang sneered, "Good, you're all so good. I guess I misjudged you!"

Lin Ruonan watched, dumbfounded. He had just broken up an entire band...

"Stop dawdling, let's go to the Student Affairs Office!" the teacher from the Student Affairs Office urged.

When they arrived, the teacher tapped on the desk and said in a gentle tone, "Fighting is wrong. According to school rules and regulations, you will be disciplined!"

Peng Haoran said, "Sir, are you talking to me?"

"I'm talking about both of you," the teacher added. "Of course, you're a student from PKU. I have no authority to criticize you, I can only contact the relevant department at your university!"

Who was he trying to threaten? Scare them first, then mediate. Trying to play games with me, huh?

Peng Haoran smiled. "Great, sir, please contact my university quickly. I didn't lay a hand on anyone today, I was chased and beaten by a student from your esteemed university the whole time. I feel very wronged right now and need a teacher from PKU to comfort me."

The teacher fell silent.

Peng Haoran urged, "Sir, hurry up and call PKU. Why aren't you dialing? Oh right, you probably don't have the number. I have it saved on my phone."

Seeing Peng Haoran take out his phone, the teacher changed his tone. "Some matters, although their nature is very... well, the good thing is that neither of you was injured..."

"So you're not calling?" Peng Haoran looked disappointed.

(That's all for today.)
